title: A Social Issue, Explained
grammar: Recap: azok a … amelyek; participles in -ó/-ő
goal: I can say which organizations or programs do something, with azok a … amelyek and olyan … amelyek.
I can describe people and groups with participles like segítő, támogató and rászoruló.
I can talk about civil help with four new words, such as civil szervezet and önkéntes munka.
I can say what felzárkózás means.
